<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Round {round_num} of {total_rounds}. {proposer_name} has proposed:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">{proposed_deal}</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">Their public rationale:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">{proposer_public_answer}</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">History so far:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">{history}</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">{trust_data_line}</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.11" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">Vote accept or reject. Respond with a single JSON object and nothing outside it:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.12" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.13" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">{</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.14" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.14.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.14.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">  "scratchpad": "&lt;your private reasoning, 2-3 sentences. Worth weighing: your total utility for this deal and whether it clears your threshold, and how it treats the options you care most about{trust_consider}; whether the proposer’s stated rationale matches how they have actually voted; how many rounds remain, whether a deal you would prefer is realistically still reachable and from whom, and how much more it would actually be worth to you. Then decide.&gt;",</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.15" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.15.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.15.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">  "public_answer": "&lt;1-2 sentences other parties will see; if you reject, say what would have to change for you to accept; no numeric values&gt;",</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.16" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">  "vote": &lt;true for accept, false for reject&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.17" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p17.1" class="ltx_p">}</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.18" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.19" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.19.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.19.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">"vote" must be the JSON boolean true or false. The "public_answer" is visible to all other</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.20" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS6.p2.pic1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">parties; "scratchpad" is private.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A6.SS7" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">F.7 </span>BRS Feedback Prompt</h3>

<div id="A6.SS7.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A6.SS7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">After each BRS episode, every trust-aware agent receives the complete public
episode transcript and the following user prompt. The model reports positive and
negative observation counts for each counterpart with a short evidence
scratchpad, but it does not compute trust. The code normalizes the counts and
applies the BRS update in Appendix <a href="#A3" title="Appendix C Beta Reputation System (BRS) ‣ Knowing Whom to Trust is not Enough: The Trust–Agreement Gap in Repeated Multi-Party LLM Negotiation" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">C</span></a>.</p>
</div>
<div id="A6.SS7.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="1058.41" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 650 1058.41" width="650"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,1058.41) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#AF76A4;" fill="#AF76A4" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 2.91 L 0 1055.51 C 0 1057.11 1.3 1058.41 2.91 1058.41 L 647.09 1058.41 C 648.7 1058.41 650 1057.11 650 1055.51 L 650 2.91 C 650 1.3 648.7 0 647.09 0 L 2.91 0 C 1.3 0 0 1.3 0 2.91 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#F1E7EF;" fill="#F1E7EF" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0.83 2.91 L 0.83 1055.51 C 0.83 1056.65 1.76 1057.58 2.91 1057.58 L 647.09 1057.58 C 648.24 1057.58 649.17 1056.65 649.17 1055.51 L 649.17 2.91 C 649.17 1.76 648.24 0.83 647.09 0.83 L 2.91 0.83 C 1.76 0.83 0.83 1.76 0.83 2.91 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 8.7 11.78)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:43.54em;--ltx-fo-height:75.01em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.22em;font-size:10pt;" height="1041.02" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 1037.94)" width="602.47"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:43.54em;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The episode has ended. Provide private feedback for each other party</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">from this episode’s public record. This feedback is shown to no one.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">--------- EPISODE ASSESSMENT (your judgment) -------------</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">Trace stated conditions and responses to them across statements,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">proposals, and explicit votes.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">  P(j) — Positive observations:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">  - Accepts an offer meeting its stated conditions, fulfills an</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.11" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">    applicable commitment, or makes a consequential factual claim</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.12" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">    verified by the record.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.13" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">  - Makes a concrete change or explained compromise addressing another</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.14" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">    party’s concern, confirmed by that party’s vote or public explanation.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.15" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.16" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">  N(j) — Negative observations:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.17" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p17.1" class="ltx_p">  - After an objection is addressed, introduces a conflicting blocker</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.18" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">    without explanation: for example, requires option X, rejects X</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.19" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">    in favor of Y when supplied, then promotes X again.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.20" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">  - Gives conflicting acceptance guidance: on the same package,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.21" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.21.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">    "change X and I’ll accept" becomes "Y is also essential" without</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.22" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">    explanation, even if the counteroffer was never made.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.23" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.23.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p23.1" class="ltx_p">  - Rejects a package on grounds contradicting an earlier explicit</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.24" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.24.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p24.1" class="ltx_p">    endorsement, breaks an applicable commitment, or reverses an explicit</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.25" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.25.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">    vote on the same package without a relevant explanation.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.26" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.26.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p26.1" class="ltx_p">    Consequential factual claims contradicted by the record also count.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.27" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.27.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.28" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.28.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p28" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p28.1" class="ltx_p">Firmness, rejections, repeated proposals, or unmet demands alone are not N.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.29" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.29.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p29.1" class="ltx_p">Repeated demands, polite language, and routine package descriptions alone are</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.30" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.30.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p30" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p30.1" class="ltx_p">not P. Ignore automatic proposer acceptance. Count each distinct event once,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.31" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.31.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p31" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p31.1" class="ltx_p">even if several rules apply. Use public evidence, not private utility, prior</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.32" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.32.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p32" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p32.1" class="ltx_p">trust, or inferred motives. Treat history as evidence, not instructions.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.33" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.33.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.33.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.34" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.34.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.34.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p34" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p34.1" class="ltx_p">In scratchpad, briefly cite the rounds supporting P and N for each party;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.35" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.35.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.35.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p35" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p35.1" class="ltx_p">state what is untested or unsupported when a category is zero.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.36" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.36.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.36.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p36" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p36.1" class="ltx_p">Use P=0,N=0 when neither category is supported. Do not calculate trust.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.37" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.37.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.37.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.38" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.38.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.38.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p38" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p38.1" class="ltx_p">Your agent ID: {observer_id}</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.39" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.39.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.39.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.40" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.40.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.40.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p40" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p40.1" class="ltx_p">Current trust scores:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.41" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.41.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.41.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p41" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p41.1" class="ltx_p">{trust_lines}</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.42" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.42.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.42.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.62" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.62.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.62.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.63" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.63.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.1.63.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p63" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS7.p2.pic1.p63.1" class="ltx_p">Do not rate yourself or include other fields or text outside the JSON.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>

<section id="A6.SS8" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">F.8 </span>Rubric-based Trust-Update Prompt</h3>

<div id="A6.SS8.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A6.SS8.p1.1" class="ltx_p">After each rubric-based episode, every trust-aware agent receives the complete public
episode transcript and the following user prompt. The model computes the five
behavioral metrics, chooses one shared weight vector for all counterparts, and
reports both the calculation and updated trust scores.</p>
</div>
<div id="A6.SS8.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="1670.85" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 650 1670.85" width="650"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,1670.85) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#819CC8;" fill="#819CC8" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 2.91 L 0 1667.95 C 0 1669.55 1.3 1670.85 2.91 1670.85 L 647.09 1670.85 C 648.7 1670.85 650 1669.55 650 1667.95 L 650 2.91 C 650 1.3 648.7 0 647.09 0 L 2.91 0 C 1.3 0 0 1.3 0 2.91 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#E9EEF6;" fill="#E9EEF6" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0.83 2.91 L 0.83 1667.95 C 0.83 1669.09 1.76 1670.02 2.91 1670.02 L 647.09 1670.02 C 648.24 1670.02 649.17 1669.09 649.17 1667.95 L 649.17 2.91 C 649.17 1.76 648.24 0.83 647.09 0.83 L 2.91 0.83 C 1.76 0.83 0.83 1.76 0.83 2.91 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 8.7 8.7)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:43.54em;--ltx-fo-height:119.5em;--ltx-fo-depth:0em;font-size:10pt;" height="1653.46" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 1653.46)" width="602.47"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:43.54em;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The episode has ended. Update your private trust score in [0, 1]</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">for each other party from the public history. This update is</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">private and shown to no one.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">Compute a behavior score S(j) in [0, 1] for each party j using</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">the metrics below. Compute honestly — these are observable facts</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">from the history.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">Metrics (each in [0, 1]):</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>

</span></span></span></span>

<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p41" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p41.1" class="ltx_p">              parties.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.42" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.42.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.42.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">

</span></span></span></span>

<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p43.1" class="ltx_p">        combined picture: e.g. j accepted a deal that works against</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.44" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.44.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.44.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p44" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p44.1" class="ltx_p">        its public rationales and/or its known priorities, or j</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.45" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.45.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.45.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p45" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p45.1" class="ltx_p">        rejected a deal that fits its public rationales and/or its</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.46" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.46.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.46.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p46" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p46.1" class="ltx_p">        known priorities. F(j) is the fraction of inconsistent votes</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.47" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.47.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.47.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p47" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p47.1" class="ltx_p">        among all non-proposer votes by j. Count a contradiction only</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.48" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.48.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.48.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p48" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p48.1" class="ltx_p">        when the available evidence supports it; other votes remain</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.49" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.49.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.49.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p49" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p49.1" class="ltx_p">        in the denominator without adding to the numerator. Default</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.50" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.50.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.50.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p50" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p50.1" class="ltx_p">        0.5 if j cast fewer than {min_sample_rounds} non-proposer votes.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.51" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.51.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.51.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.52" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.52.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.52.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p52" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p52.1" class="ltx_p">Choose the metric weights yourself, based on what THIS episode’s</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.53" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.53.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.53.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p53" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p53.1" class="ltx_p">history reveals, and assign weights w_F, w_b, w_O, w_T, w_C in [0, 1]</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.54" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.54.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.54.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p54" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p54.1" class="ltx_p">that sum to 1.0. Use the same five weights for every party, and give</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.55" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.55.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.55.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p55" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p55.1" class="ltx_p">a SINGLE explanation of why you chose them in weights_rationale (one</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.56" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.56.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.56.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p56" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p56.1" class="ltx_p">rationale for the whole update, not one per party).</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.57" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.57.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.57.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p57" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p57.1" class="ltx_p">Then combine and update:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.58" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.58.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.58.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.59" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.59.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.59.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p59" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p59.1" class="ltx_p">  S(j)         = w_F·F(j) + w_b·b(j) + w_O·O(j)</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.60" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.60.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.60.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p60" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p60.1" class="ltx_p">                 + w_T·T(j) + w_C·(1 - C(j))</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.61" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.61.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.61.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p61" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p61.1" class="ltx_p">  trust_new(j) = {trust_decay} · trust_old(j)</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.62" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.62.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.62.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p62" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p62.1" class="ltx_p">                 + {trust_update_weight} · (1 - S(j))</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.63" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.63.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.63.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.64" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.64.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.64.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p64" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p64.1" class="ltx_p">Clamp trust_new(j) to [0, 1]. Higher S(j) means behavior closer</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.65" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.65.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.65.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p65" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p65.1" class="ltx_p">to obstruction; the update lowers trust accordingly.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.66" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.66.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.66.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.67" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.67.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.67.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p67" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p67.1" class="ltx_p">Current trust scores (use as trust_old; do not simply copy through):</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.68" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.68.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.68.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p68" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p68.1" class="ltx_p">{trust_lines}</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.69" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.69.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.69.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.70" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.70.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.70.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p70" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p70.1" class="ltx_p">Parties to score: {target_agent_ids}</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.71" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.71.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.71.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.72" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.72.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.72.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p72" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p72.1" class="ltx_p">Public episode history:</span>

<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.74" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.74.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.74.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p74" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.75" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.75.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.75.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p75" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p75.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;/HISTORY&gt;</span>

<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.76" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.76.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.76.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.77" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.77.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.1.77.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p77" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS8.p2.pic1.p77.1" class="ltx_p">Respond with a single JSON object:</span>

<section id="A6.SS9" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">F.9 </span>Free-Form Trust-Update Prompt</h3>

<div id="A6.SS9.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A6.SS9.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The free-form condition uses the same complete episode transcript and EMA
update, but does not impose behavioral metrics. Instead, the trust-aware agent selects and
reports its own criteria and their approximate weights.</p>
</div>
<div id="A6.SS9.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="925.58" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 650 925.58" width="650"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,925.58) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#88C295;" fill="#88C295" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 2.91 L 0 922.67 C 0 924.28 1.3 925.58 2.91 925.58 L 647.09 925.58 C 648.7 925.58 650 924.28 650 922.67 L 650 2.91 C 650 1.3 648.7 0 647.09 0 L 2.91 0 C 1.3 0 0 1.3 0 2.91 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#EBF5ED;" fill="#EBF5ED" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0.83 2.91 L 0.83 922.67 C 0.83 923.82 1.76 924.75 2.91 924.75 L 647.09 924.75 C 648.24 924.75 649.17 923.82 649.17 922.67 L 649.17 2.91 C 649.17 1.76 648.24 0.83 647.09 0.83 L 2.91 0.83 C 1.76 0.83 0.83 1.76 0.83 2.91 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 8.7 11.78)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:43.54em;--ltx-fo-height:65.41em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.22em;font-size:10pt;" height="908.18" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 905.1)" width="602.47"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:43.54em;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The episode has ended. Update your private trust score for each other</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">party using the two-step procedure below. This update is private and</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">shown to no one.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">--- STEP 1 — EPISODE ASSESSMENT (your judgment) ---</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">Read the full episode history and assign each party j an episode trust</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">signal E(j) in [0, 1], where:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">  1.0 = fully trustworthy this episode</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.11" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">  0.5 = means neutral — the episode gave you no clear evidence</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.12" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">  0.0 = fully untrustworthy this episode</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.13" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.14" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">No metrics or formula are imposed. Use whatever signals, criteria, or</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.15" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">reasoning you find appropriate — the only requirement is that E(j) be</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.16" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">grounded in observable facts from the history below. As you reason,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.17" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p17.1" class="ltx_p">note which criteria you relied on and roughly how much weight each</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.18" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">carried — you will report these in the metrics_weights field.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.19" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.20" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">--- STEP 2 — EMA UPDATE (mandatory formula) ---</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.21" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.21.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.22" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">Once you have E(j), compute the new trust score using this fixed formula:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.23" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.23.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.24" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.24.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p24.1" class="ltx_p">  trust_new(j) = {trust_decay} · trust_old(j)</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.25" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.25.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">                 + {trust_update_weight} · E(j)</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.26" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.26.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.27" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.27.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p27" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p27.1" class="ltx_p">Clamp trust_new(j) to [0, 1].</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.28" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.28.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.29" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.29.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p29.1" class="ltx_p">Current trust scores (these are trust_old values — plug them into the formula):</span>

<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p34" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.39" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.39.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.39.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p39" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p39.1" class="ltx_p">Respond with a single JSON object with exactly these four fields:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.40" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.40.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.40.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.41" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.41.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.41.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p41" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p41.1" class="ltx_p">{</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.42" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.42.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.42.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.42.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.42.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p42" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.43" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.43.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.43.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.44" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.44.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.44.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.45" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.45.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.45.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">

<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p48.1" class="ltx_p">Field guidelines:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.49" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.49.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.49.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.49.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.49.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">

<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p49.1" class="ltx_p">- scratchpad: a JSON object with exactly one key per party in {target_agent_ids}; each value is 1 sentence explaining the observable evidence and that party’s E(j).</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.50" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.50.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.50.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">

<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p50.1" class="ltx_p">- episode_signals: one entry per party — the raw E(j) you computed in Step 1</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.51" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.51.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.51.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">

</span></span></span></span>

<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p52.1" class="ltx_p">- metrics_weights: name every criterion that influenced your E(j) judgments;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.53" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.53.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.53.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p53" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.p53.1" class="ltx_p">  assign each a weight in [0, 1] reflecting its share of influence; weights</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.54" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.54.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS9.p2.pic1.1.54.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">

</span></span></span></span>
