<section id="A6.SS10" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">F.10 </span>Prompt Rendering and Histories</h3>

<div id="A6.SS10.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A6.SS10.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The system prompt is regenerated for every proposal, vote, and trust-update
call. Proposal and voting calls receive the most recent (n) completed rounds;
if earlier rounds are omitted, the history begins with <span id="A6.SS10.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">&lt;omitted/&gt;</span>.
The first decision instead receives <span id="A6.SS10.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">This is the first interaction;
there is no prior history yet.</span> A completed round is rendered in the following
form for negotiation decisions:</p>
</div>
<div id="A6.SS10.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="161.77" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 650 161.77" width="650"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,161.77) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#949494;" fill="#949494" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 2.91 L 0 158.87 C 0 160.47 1.3 161.77 2.91 161.77 L 647.09 161.77 C 648.7 161.77 650 160.47 650 158.87 L 650 2.91 C 650 1.3 648.7 0 647.09 0 L 2.91 0 C 1.3 0 0 1.3 0 2.91 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#EDEDED;" fill="#EDEDED" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0.83 2.91 L 0.83 158.87 C 0.83 160.01 1.76 160.94 2.91 160.94 L 647.09 160.94 C 648.24 160.94 649.17 160.01 649.17 158.87 L 649.17 2.91 C 649.17 1.76 648.24 0.83 647.09 0.83 L 2.91 0.83 C 1.76 0.83 0.83 1.76 0.83 2.91 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 8.7 9.86)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:43.54em;--ltx-fo-height:10.35em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.08em;font-size:10pt;" height="144.37" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 143.21)" width="602.47"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:43.54em;">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;round id="{round_id}"&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;proposal by="{proposer_name}" accept="implicit"&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">

<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;deal&gt;{"I1": "I1o1", ..., "I5": "I5o1"}&lt;/deal&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">

<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;rationale&gt;{public_proposal_rationale}&lt;/rationale&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;/proposal&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;vote by="{voter_name}" decision="accept|reject"&gt;{public_vote_rationale}&lt;/vote&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">...</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;outcome&gt;PASSED|FAILED&lt;/outcome&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:457.2pt;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:457.2pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:457.2pt;">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS10.p2.pic1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;/round&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
<div id="A6.SS10.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A6.SS10.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Post-episode trust calls receive the complete episode transcript. To preserve
the representation used in the experiments, their proposal line encodes the
package as <span id="A6.SS10.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">deal="I1:I1o1 ... I5:I5o1"</span>; all rationales, votes, and
outcomes remain public-history evidence. Trust-update output keys use canonical
agent identifiers, whereas trust values shown during negotiation use display
names. The runtime appends a deterministic session nonce to each user message
when run entropy is enabled; this implementation-only value is omitted from the
templates above. Provider-specific wrappers may transmit the system and user
text differently, but do not change their logical content.</p>
</div>
